brief: Traceable, minimalist multivitamins by subscription ($33-ish a month). We talk a lot about transparency. Looking at women 25-45.

profile.business_summary: Traceable, minimalist multivitamins for women aged 25-45, offered via a monthly subscription model with a strong focus on transparency.

relevant_tags.why: The product is sold exclusively via a monthly subscription model.
The primary target demographic is women aged 25-45.
Traceability and transparency strongly appeal to natural-focused consumers.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Advertiser is a subscription-only multivitamin for personal daily use.

note_signals.why: Daily Form's science-forward, skeptical audience will highly appreciate the advertiser's focus on transparency and traceability.

Movewell has a strong female audience with high crossover in wellness, making it an ideal host.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.75-$1.00 per click (median $0.84), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.75-$1.00 (median $0.84); bidding $0.63 wins ~5% of page views, paying ~$0.58 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands

phases.why: stable bids so measured rates aren't confounded

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
